paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM. SepLLM achieves lower loss different computation costs and different training time consistently.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPS and Loss for two different models. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPS" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.00e+00 to 1.00e+00, with tick labels at increments of 0.25. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and has a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75. A purple, solid line with triangle markers represents one data series, starting at a value of approximately 2.74 at x=0.00 and decreasing to approximately 2.54 at x=1.00. A red, solid line with circle markers represents the second data series, beginning at approximately 2.72 at x=0.00 and decreasing to approximately 2.48 at x=1.00. A horizontal dashed line is present at y=2.55.
